title: GET /search/semantic has no explicit bound on q length; any search-scope caller can send ~16KB per request into the paid embedder
evidence: Executed with fakes: q of 12000 chars returned 200 and the 12000-char string reached deps.search unchanged. Only incidental bound is Node max header size (~16KB URL; a 200000-char q gave ECONNRESET). route.ts checks only q.trim() non-empty. Lexical /search has the same shape, but there the cost is local CPU, not a billed embedding call.
fix_direction: Reject q longer than a stated cap (e.g. 1000-2000 chars) with 400 before deps.search; add a route test at cap and cap+1.

title: Flag wiring in composition/production.ts is untested: replacing `semanticSearchEnabled() && chains.embedding` with `chains.embedding` survives all semantic-search tests
evidence: Mutation M7 (hash c77.. file 1a5b309df221 -> ee44d74810c9), route+store tests: fail=0, SURVIVED. Flag-off absence is tested only at server.ts level (deps.semanticSearch absent), and semanticSearchEnabled() only in isolation; the one line joining them is unpinned, so the flag could silently be bypassed.
fix_direction: Test buildProductionDeps (or extract the gating into a pure helper) asserting semanticSearch is undefined when LKB_SEMANTIC_SEARCH is unset/0 even with an embedding chain.
